crossRefs.note: but, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries…
I listened and heard, but they didn’t say what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, saying, “What have I done?”…
Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed. They couldn’t blush. Therefore…
Then they said, “Come! Let’s devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won’t perish from the priest, nor counsel from…
Then the princes said to the king, “Please let this man be put to death; because he weakens the hands of the men of war…
Pharaoh said, “Who is Yahweh, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know Yahweh, and moreover I…
Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
“Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”
They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul!…
Now if you are ready whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music…
But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’
But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’ ”

translations.web: “As for the word that you have spoken to us in Yahweh’s name, we will not listen to you.
translations.bsb: “As for the word you have spoken to us in the name of the LORD, we will not listen to you!
translations.kjv: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the LORD, we will not hearken
translations.asv: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of Jehovah, we will not hearken unto thee.
